supporting_observations.claim: The alerted host made repeated HTTPS CONNECT requests to update.chartmate-imaging.net from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC, with successful proxy tunnels at 13:38, 13:47, 13:58, 14:03, and 14:08; other attempts returned 407 or 502.

The outbound connections are attributed by endpoint network telemetry to cmupdate.exe running from Ben Carter's user-writable AppData\Local\ChartMate directory, rather than the organization's inventoried ChartMate updater path under Program Files; the observed destination is also .net rather than the inventoried .com domain. This mismatch makes the activity suspicious and consistent with possible masquerading, though it does not by itself prove malicious content.

The same cmupdate.exe process was created under Ben Carter's interactive session and made the proxied connections; telemetry also records a file-creation event targeting that executable while it was running.

known_telemetry_limitations: The HTTPS traffic is recorded as proxy CONNECT tunnels; these records do not expose the encrypted request or response contents.
The provided evidence does not include the executable's hash, signature, reputation, or a verified vendor installation record.
Some periodic attempts failed at the proxy, so the logs do not establish that every attempted connection reached the destination.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish whether the AppData executable is a legitimate per-user ChartMate build or an unauthorized lookalike.
The evidence does not establish that the executable downloaded or executed a malicious payload.
The evidence does not establish what data, if any, was sent in the successful HTTPS tunnels.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire the executable and validate its hash, digital signature, origin, and file history, including the recorded file-creation event.
Confirm with ChartMate or the organization's software owner whether the AppData installation and update.chartmate-imaging.net are legitimate.
Obtain proxy TLS inspection or destination-side telemetry, if available, to determine the contents and purpose of the successful sessions.
Review endpoint execution and file events for any downloaded or launched payloads associated with this process.
unrelated_findings: WS-BCARTER-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB, and FILE-HD-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. This is outside the alerted HTTPS activity and should be reviewed separately. (T015-00253, T015-00257)
